visualReview.notes: All nine portable and nine shared final frames inspected, with full-resolution northern panels view. Red-white-red taper, recessed plank door, two-rail gallery, lantern frame and connected roof finial render without visible gaps.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Fine shared lime plaster replaces oversized exposed-stone joints to match the national tourism photograph. Paint bands remain continuous; small inclined panels and metal framing retain independent material contrast.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-QID node establishes the island tower center; orthographic capture confirms that anchor. Circular silhouette has no preferred footprint axis. Small southern door and northern panels are explicitly photograph-reconstructed compass positions, and host terrain supplies the rocky island.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Provincial11m height and national tourism exterior photograph support the compact taper, three paint bands, low door, gallery lip, black lantern and paired inclined panels. Reusable rough paint surface captures the exterior character without individual copied weathering; natural rock and birds are host features.
